datasets.name: MASSIVE Arabic (Saudi Arabia locale)
datasets.source_method: Localized from the English SLURP voice-assistant dataset.
datasets.annotation_method: Human localization with additional quality judgments included in the release.
datasets.variety_claim: Arabic locale for Saudi Arabia; not evidence of native-authored Saudi sub-dialects.

datasets.name: AraTox
datasets.source_method: Real-world Arabic social-media text reported by the authors.
datasets.annotation_method: Human multi-label annotation reported by the authors.
datasets.variety_claim: Reported coverage of Gulf, Levantine, Nile Basin, North African, Yemeni, and MSA.
known_limitations: Released rows do not contain per-item dialect labels
Social-media sampling can introduce demographic and topic bias
The binary pilot collapses the richer multi-label ontology

datasets.name: IADD DART common-source region subset

license.data: NO EXPLICIT REPOSITORY LICENSE; paper is CC BY 4.0

datasets.source_method: IADD integrates DART, SHAMI, TSAC, PADIC, and AOC. The benchmark manifest uses only DART so all five region labels share one source.
datasets.annotation_method: DART is reported as crowdsourced dialect annotation; IADD harmonizes region labels.
datasets.variety_claim: Five region labels: Gulf, Egyptian, Levantine, Maghrebi, and Iraqi.
known_limitations: Repository has no explicit dataset license
Evaluation-only: do not redistribute source text
Region labels are coarse and cannot establish country-level performance
Social-media text and legacy collection period may not represent current usage
datasets.redistribution: Do not redistribute text; publish aggregate results and item hashes only
